items.title: Number Input (Motion)
items.description: NumberInput with motion: odometer digits that spin as far as the number travelled, steppers that repeat when held, and a limit you can feel: the number strains against it, harder with each push.

items.name: motion-slider
items.title: Slider (Motion)
items.description: Slider with motion: a rubber-band stretch past the ends, a strain from the keyboard, and the value on odometer wheels in a bubble that leans as you drag.

items.name: motion-dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu (Motion)
items.description: DropdownMenu with motion: it springs out of its trigger, its items rise in one after another, and one highlight glides from item to item after the pointer or the arrow keys.

items.name: motion-select
items.title: Select (Motion)
items.description: Select with motion: the list springs out of its trigger with its options rising in, one highlight glides between them, and a new value rises into the trigger.

items.name: motion-popover
items.title: Popover (Motion)
items.description: Popover with motion: it springs out of its trigger from the side it opens on, and glides to its new height when what's inside changes.

items.name: motion-progress
items.title: Progress (Motion)
items.description: Progress with motion: the bar glides to each value on a spring, runs while the length is unknown, shines when it's done, and can show its percentage on odometer wheels.

items.name: motion-sidebar
items.title: Sidebar (Motion)
items.description: Sidebar with motion: it springs its width as it folds, the current page's highlight and the hover glide from row to row, and sections open on a gliding height.

items.name: motion-alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog (Motion)
items.description: AlertDialog with motion: it grows out of its button, its icon pops in, a click outside shakes it because it needs an answer, and confirm can be a press-and-hold.

theme.font-heading: var(--font-geist, "Geist"), var(--font-inter, "Inter"), var(--font-arabic, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic"), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

items.name: motion-input-otp
items.title: Input OTP (Motion)
items.description: InputOTP with motion: each character pops into its box, the focus glides from box to box, an error shakes the row and a full code ripples.

items.name: motion-time-picker
items.title: Time Picker (Motion)
items.description: TimePicker with motion: the list springs out of its trigger, one highlight glides over the times, the tick draws, and a new time rises into the trigger.

items.name: motion-toggle
items.title: Toggle (Motion)
items.description: Toggle with motion: it presses in, its background pops in from the middle and its icon bounces as it turns on.

items.name: motion-toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group (Motion)
items.description: ToggleGroup with motion: with type="single" one background springs between the toggles; with "multiple" each pops in and out.

items.name: motion-kbd
items.title: Kbd (Motion)
items.description: Kbd with motion: its keys press in as you hold the real ones on your keyboard.
